firstNightReminder: Show the character token of one of the Demon's bluffs.
name: Kurt
ability: You start knowing one of the Demon's bluffs.

firstNightReminder: Show the character token of an evil role not in play.
otherNightReminder: If Mariannes has not yet used their ability: Mariannes either shows a 'no' head signal, or Mariannes dies and Sofia is revived, and the Mariannes does not receive a ghost vote.
name: Mariannes
ability: You start knowing an evil player not in play. Once per game, you can choose to die to revive Sofia. If Sofia is revived in this way, your ghost vote will not count.

firstNightReminder: Point to any number of evil players.
name: Literally Merlin
ability: You start knowing any number of evil players. If good would have won, the evil team discusses and a minion chooses someone. If they choose Literally Merlin, your team loses.

firstNightReminder: Show the hand signal for the number (1, 2, 3, etc.) of in-play characters that have abilities to make players drunk or poisoned.
name: Matt
ability: You start knowing the number of in-play roles that have abilities to make players drunk or poisoned.

firstNightReminder: Will points to a player. If that player is a Townsfolk: Will dies when the chosen Townsfolk also dies.
name: Will
ability: During the first night, choose a player. If they are a townsfolk, you die when they die. You can not die to the demon.

firstNightReminder: Show the finger signal (0, 1, 2) for the number of abilities used on or involed with Derek
name: Derek
ability: Each night, learn how many players used or involved their ability on you, even if dead.

otherNightReminder: If Moira has not yet used their ability: Moira either shows a 'no' head signal, or show the finger signal (0, 1, 2) for the number of evil characters choosing to trust Moira.
name: Moira
ability: Anyone can openly claim to trust the Moira. Once per game, at night, you can learn how many characters who trust you are evil, a Christina counts for two.

otherNightReminder: If Larry sat out of the public discussion today, Larry can visit you to learn a piece of useful information
name: Larry
ability: You can choose to sit out of the public discourse, if you do, you can visit the storyteller the next day to gain a useful piece of information. There can not be more Larry claims than the number of private areas.

name: Cas
ability: Once per game, you may make everyone but you including the storyteller silent for the rest of the phase [Night, Dawn, Day, Nomination] or they will be executed. Anytime you are mad, you are instead mad you are Literally Merlin.

otherNightReminder: If Tommy has not yet used their ability twice: Tommy either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to either one or two players, they are drunk for tonight and tomorrow day.
name: Tommy
ability: Twice per game at night, choose a player, they are drunk for tonight and tomorrow day.

firstNightReminder: Javari Chunch either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to another player: one of them is marked Defeated, the other is marked the Victor.
otherNightReminder: If Javari Chunch has not yet used their ability while it is once per game: Javari Chunch either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to another player: one of them is marked Defeated, the other is marked the Victor tonight and tommorow day.
name: Javari Chunch
ability: Once per game or once per night, choose a player, one of you might die, one of you might not die tonight and tomorrow day. You will be woken up along with the first non-Demon player to wake up.

otherNightReminder: If Nate has not yet used their ability: Nate either shows a 'no' head signal, or show the finger signal (0, 1, 2) for the number of evil characters alive
name: Nate
ability: Once per game*, at night, you may learn how many evil players are alive. If you have been mad you were a role this game, you are drunk.

otherNightReminder: Kiara points to a player and a role. That player is mad they are that role or their own role tomorrow.
name: Kiara
ability: Each night*, you may choose someone and a role. They are mad they are either that role or their own role tomorrow, or they might die.

firstNightReminder: Isabelle points to a player and shows the finger signal (0, 1, 2) for the number of nights until they become revived.
otherNightReminder: Isabelle either shows a 'no' head signal, shows thumbs down to cancel the previous revival, or points to a player and shows the finger signal (0, 1, 2) for the number of nights until they become revived.
name: Isabelle
ability: During the first night, and once per game at night, choose a player and a number. The chosen player revives after that many nights, but you can cancel at any time.

otherNightReminder: If the character Eamon (Gay) chatted with first is the same gender as Eamon (Gay), give the head signal (nod yes, shake no) for if they were drunk or poisoned.
name: Eamon (Gay)
ability: If the character you first have a private conversation with is the same gender as you, tonight you learn if they were drunk/poisoned. If you are nominated by someone of the opposite gender from you, you might die. If you are mad you are Eamon, you might be executed.

name: Logan Maue
ability: The first player you talk to privately is unaffected by the demon tonight, except for Sofia.

name: Sofia
ability: If you are involved in/with finding true information, you die when it is publicly (hard-claim) revealed. If you throw up you die.

otherNightReminder: If Breen was not mad that exactly one game-relevant false statement was true yesterday, Breen might die.
name: Breen
ability: Each day, you must be (hard-claim) mad that exactly one game-relevant false statement is true or else you might die tonight.

name: Ryan Jenoski
ability: Even if dead, the number of times the Storyteller hears something Ryan Jenoski says tonight and today, the number of votes needed to put someone on the block might be reduced. If you kiss Kyle, he dies.

otherNightReminder: Yaokai points to a player, Yaokai must convince that player Yaokai is evil, or they might be executed.
name: Yaokai
ability: Each night*, choose a player: you must convince them you are evil, or you might be executed. If you are executed, someone becomes drunk.

name: Abigail
ability: You always register as sober and healthy, even if drunk or poisoned.

firstNightReminder: If Kyle has not yet used their ability: Kyle either shows a 'no' head signal, or changes an element on the grimoire. You may cheat once after this.
name: Kyle
ability: Once per game, you may look at the grimoire and modify one grimoire element in any one way except delete player tokens. The Storyteller may cheat once after you do this.

name: Eamon (Straight)
ability: If the character you first have a private conversation with is the same gender as you, they are poisoned. If you are nominated by someone of the same gender as you, you might die. If you are mad you are Eamon, you might be executed.

firstNightReminder: Merry Ann's points to a player. If they use their ability tonight or tomorrow day, its effects are delayed by one day, or two if choosing a Larry.
otherNightReminder: Merry Ann's points to a player. If they use their ability tonight or tomorrow day, its effects are delayed by one day, or two if choosing a Larry.
name: Merry Ann's
ability: Each night, choose a player, if they use their ability by dusk tomorrow, it is delayed by exactly one day. A chosen Larry is delayed by two days.

firstNightReminder: Kamil points to a player. If they activate at night, activate them last in the night order.
otherNightReminder: Kamil points to a player. If they activate at night, activate them last in the night order.
name: Kamil
ability: Each night, choose a player: they activate last in the night order.

firstNightReminder: Wake up Christina. Show them their minions and their bluffs. Christina points to a player. That player either gives their ability to an evil character, or uses it on a good player. They die tommorow night. For the rest of the game, if that player is mad they were chosen by Christina, someone will be executed.
otherNightReminder: Christina points to a player. That player either gives their ability to an evil character, or uses it on a good player. They die tommorow night. For the rest of the game, if that player is mad they were chosen by Christina, someone will be executed.
name: Christina
ability: Each night, choose a player, for the rest of the game they can not be mad they were chosen by Christina or someone will be executed, even if dead. If their ability is positive, they give it to an evil player tomorrow. If their ability is negative, they use it on a good player. They die tommorow night.

firstNightReminder: Wake up Upper Crust. Show them their minions and their bluffs.
otherNightReminder: Upper Crust points to up to three players. They will become poisoned any time by dusk today. Anyone who has been poisoned three distinct times dies.
name: Upper Crust
ability: Each night, choose up to three players: they will be posioned any time by dusk today, but may become healthy later. Anyone poisoned three distinct times in any way will die.

firstNightReminder: Wake up both Couples. Show them their minions and their bluffs.
otherNightReminder: The Couples point to a player. That player dies. If only couple is alive, that player dies even if they could not.
name: Couple
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If only one Couple is alive, the chosen player dies, even if for some reason they could not. If both Couples are alive or dead at the end of the game, evil wins. [+1 Couple, -1 Outsider]

firstNightReminder: Wake up 27 Year Old Austin. Show them their minions and their bluffs.
otherNightReminder: Choose any of the players the 27 Year Old Austin talked to privately today. Those players die.
name: 27 Year Old Austin
ability: Anyone who you talk to privately during the day may die tonight. If you only talk to one townsfolk, another townsfolk may die. If you do not talk to anyone, the Storyteller chooses who dies.
